note: Bavli: [Ketubot 65a:9](sefaria:Ketubot.65a.9) (30 segments). Gazetteer: “The wife of Abaye”. Woman named by her husband. Named examples: ברוריא דביתהו דרבי מאיר ([Avodah Zarah 18a:14](sefaria:Avodah_Zarah.18a.14)), אימא שלום דביתהו דרבי אליעזר ([Bava Metzia 59b:10](sefaria:Bava_Metzia.59b.10)). Neither דביתהו nor ברוריה is in the paper.

Bavli: [Ketubot 56b:12](sefaria:Ketubot.56b.12) (8 segments). Gazetteer: “The sister of Rami bar Ḥama”. Sister of X. Paper has אחי / אחוה דX (brother) and בר אחתיה דX (sister's son) but not the sister herself. Also אימא שלום ... אחתיה דרבן גמליאל.

item: בר חמוה דX / בן חמיו של X
note: Bavli: [Bava Kamma 112a:14](sefaria:Bava_Kamma.112a.14) (5 segments). Gazetteer: “the son of Mar Ukva’s father-in-law”. Brother-in-law named via the father-in-law. Also 'Rabbi Yehoshua ben Zeruz, son of the father-in-law of Rabbi Meir' (בן חמיו של רבי מאיר, [Chullin 6b:5](sefaria:Chullin.6b.5)). Paper has חמוה דX only.

item: אחי אמו של X / אחוה דאמיה
note: Bavli: [Bava Kamma 55a:2](sefaria:Bava_Kamma.55a.2) (6 segments). Gazetteer: “Shmuel bar Naḥum, the brother of the mother of Rav Aḥa, son of Rabbi Ḥanina”. Maternal uncle. Also רבי שמעון בן איסי בן לקוניא אחות דאמיה ([Bava Metzia 85a:9](sefaria:Bava_Metzia.85a.9)). Same segment has the alternative 'אבי אמו של רב אחי' (maternal grandfather).

Bavli: [Ketubot 63b:9](sefaria:Ketubot.63b.9) (11 segments). Gazetteer: “Ḥanina’s daughter-in-law”. Woman named as daughter-in-law of a man: כלתיה דרב זביד ([Ketubot 63b:9](sefaria:Ketubot.63b.9)), כלתו של רבי אושעיא ([Eruvin 80a:7](sefaria:Eruvin.80a.7)), כלתו של רבי שבתי ([Ketubot 96a:8](sefaria:Ketubot.96a.8)), כלת (רבי) חנינא ([Niddah 24b:12](sefaria:Niddah.24b.12)). The list has חמוה דX and חתניה דX, but not כלתיה דX.
